Been suffering with an ear infection for weeks because I know it’s pointless trying to get an appointment. Relented Monday thru sheer pain and was sent on a wild goose chase of bein sent to a pharmacist, pharmacist sent me back to Gordon street where the receptionist said she’d resubmit my request to see a doctor. I was then sent a link to book an appointment… no appointments it said so rang receptionist back who then told me to keep trying the link for 4 days after 4 days if I’ve still not managed to get an appointment ring back and they will give me an appointment over the phone!!
Fast forward to Wednesday and I’ve been accepted at a new doctor’s surgery, where I’ve had a telephone consultation, been prescribed an antibiotic spray and got a f2f appointment for Friday for a check up. Why is Gordon street accepting new patients when they can’t or won’t look after the patients they’ve already got. Absolute shocking place!! Avoid at all
